ux_analysis.user_goal: User wants to extract drum patterns from an audio loop AND immediately apply them to the step sequencer, skipping the manual 'save to library then load from library' workflow
ux_analysis.current_friction: Currently 'Learn Pattern from Audio' only saves patterns to UserPatternDatabase. User must then open Pattern Library dialog, find the pattern, and apply it - a 3+ step process
ux_analysis.proposed_solution: Add a new menu item 'Learn & Apply to Sequencer' that performs pattern extraction, shows PatternPreviewDialog for review/editing, and on acceptance directly injects the pattern into StepSequencer with visual feedback
ux_analysis.fastest_path: Single right-click action -> review in dialog -> accept -> immediate visual confirmation in sequencer

component_hierarchy.description: Component tree showing how pattern injection flows through the system

user_flow.description: Step-by-step user interaction flow for the new feature

steps.action: User right-clicks on a drum loop sample tile in Sample Browser
steps.system_response: PopupMenu appears with options including new 'Learn & Apply to Sequencer'
System loads audio, extracts patterns via MultiBandPatternExtractor, opens PatternPreviewDialog

steps.action: User reviews patterns in dialog, optionally adjusts grid/toggles categories
steps.system_response: Dialog shows waveform with beat grid overlay, category rows with on/off steps
Dialog returns Result with accepted=true, closes modal
System converts Result.patterns to PatternSet structure
For each category in pattern not present in sequencer, calls addTrackRow()
Calls applyPatternSet() with converted PatternSet, updates grid data
Calls highlightRows() with list of affected row indices, starts fade timer
Affected rows glow cyan, fade from alpha 0.6 to 0.0 over 300ms
User sees new pattern in sequencer, can immediately play/edit
